answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 26290 Country: India Title: I am living in one place Aheri with my family. and i am working at Ballarshaha 100 km away from Aheri. i stayed there 3 to 4 day in week. what is direction about Namaj? which type of namaj aplicable? KASAR or full? Question: i am living in one place Aheri with my family. and i am working at Ballarshaha 100 km away from Aheri. i stayed there 3 to 4 day in week. what is direction about Namaj? which type of namaj aplicable? KASAR or full? Answer ID: 26290 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2371/H=854/th=1431) If you intend to stay in Ballarshaha for two or three days, then you will do qasr there i.e. if you pray alone or behind a musafir imam you will do qasr Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
